channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Nov 22
item.description:
120 development commits

Map Layout & Monument Placement

  • Monuments are arranged in eccentric rings with the endgame core shifted to one side, the Power Plant placed centrally, and core monuments leaning inward and pinned to specific rings.
  • Core monuments are now guarded and monitored; a helicopter delivers reinforcements to weakened cores and a Bradley vehicle patrols them.
  • The first closing balloon is positioned in the outer ring away from hatches, and the raid map now uses a fixed seed (1929212934) for consistent generation.

AI & Combat Enhancements

  • Each Tier‑2 monument now spawns a gunner drone that fires pistol rounds and experiences recoil kickback.
  • Players near a monument receive a warning when reinforcements are inbound, and all players are warned before a balloon closes.

Economy, Pricing & Loot

  • Item worth is calculated from supply stock and a fixed shop list, removing bandit‑camp pricing; gold‑floor items, condition‑scaled sales, and blueprint prices are standardized.
  • Loot tiers are fixed per item (with a few manual overrides); prices no longer change based on colour; low‑tier crates and barrels contain fewer tools/weapons, and junk‑pile crates no longer drop ring parts.
  • A new economic trial is enabled by default: the shop purchases only finished goods, while components are sent to a recycler that refunds their sale value.
  • An economy log now records every raider’s activity, and the safe pocket rejects weapons, armour, and contraband, valuing items as the shop would pay.

Inventory & Stash Adjustments

  • The player stash now expands by two rows at a time, up to a total of 96 slots.
  • The large backpack’s sell price is set to 400 after completing the Missing Shipment quest.

Extraction & Raids

  • Extraction balloons no longer carry an extra hot‑air balloon, fixing duplicate balloon spawns under each extraction balloon.
  • Escape hatches can now be opened with a Cobalt bypass card; a rare jackpot item appears in outer‑ring crates, and raid duration is extended to 35 minutes.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Adjusted beach spawn locations to reduce player clustering and improve early-game safety.
  • Enhanced fishing vendor with expanded inventory and more balanced pricing, making fishing a more viable income source.
  • Fixed train tunnel generation overlap bugs, eliminating map glitches that could trap players.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Nov 21
item.description:
68 development commits

NPC & AI

  • Fixed lambs getting stuck and failing to follow a sprinting player when led.
  • Scout NPCs that become trapped against signs or poles now automatically free themselves.

Monuments & World

  • Monument guard NPCs now spread out, scale with monument size, and can stand on any floor.
  • Raid maps now spawn only whitelisted monuments, with each tier‑1 monument appearing once per map.

UI & Quality of Life

  • Stash UI no longer repeats the bank balance, showing the correct amount only.
  • Bank balance is now always displayed on the Outpost screen for continuous fund monitoring.

item.title: Rust Development Updates — Nov 20
item.description:
155 development commits

Gameplay & Combat

  • Added the M79 grenade launcher, a new explosive weapon for players.
  • Introduced a convar to enable modern sprint strafing, allowing more fluid movement while sprinting.

Movement & Camera

  • Shoulder camera now responds more dynamically: it follows forward/backward and vertical movement without drift, adjusts distance when crouched, leans with speed changes, reacts to melee hits, and briefly pauses after hard landings.
  • Vehicle and mount chase cameras now have distinct profiles with smooth easing when mounting or dismounting and a configurable range for tuning.
  • Spectator view no longer experiences slow‑motion; it now correctly follows the target without lag.

World & Environment

  • Train tunnel rail links are prevented from spawning too close to lakes, eliminating blocked tunnels and terrain carving issues.
  • Fixed multiple base occlusion and deployable visibility issues, including foundation placement errors, deployables on roofs and seams, dropbox visibility through walls, and placement problems in tall rooms.

Extraction & Raid Flow

  • Extraction improvements: failed jobs now return cargo, ground rope physics and cable tool behavior are fixed, bow handling is steadier, and walking animations are smoother with hip turning on diagonals.
  • Raid entry and exit now feature a black screen with a hatch sound, and returning home after a raid places you beside the deploy point behind the summary screen.

Economy & Storage

  • Scrap is now kept in a central bank at the hub rather than in individual stash slots.

Audio & Immersion

  • Engine sounds now correctly play for pooled vehicles, fixing silent or overlapping audio.
